trap.label: revisão (passiva, decide to)
trap.wrong: Cars are build here. They refused paying. I had cleaned my sofa by a company.
trap.right: Cars are built here. They refused to pay. I had my sofa cleaned by a company.
trap.why: Revisão da unidade 7: o brasileiro esquece o particípio da passiva, usa -ing depois de refuse e coloca o verbo no lugar errado em have + pp. Em inglês: be + pp; refuse + to; have + obj + pp.

fix.right: We agreed to meet at six.

fix.wrong: She had cut her hair at salon.
fix.right: She had her hair cut at a salon.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “They close the roads at night.”
rewrite.answer: The roads are closed at night.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com refuse: “He said no to paying.”
Reescreva: “A dentist checked my teeth.” (I had...)
